title: Corporate taxable income — Harrow Industries
instructions: Compute Harrow Industries' 2025 taxable income and tax from its book income. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Book income before federal income tax: $900,000
exhibits.content:
It includes or reflects:
- Dividends from a 25%-owned domestic corporation: **$100,000**
- Municipal bond interest: **$20,000**
- Fines paid to a state agency: **$10,000** (deducted)
- Business meals: **$30,000** (deducted)
- Client entertainment: **$8,000** (deducted)
- Charitable contributions: **$120,000** (deducted)
- Net capital loss: **$15,000** (deducted)

rows.label: Taxable income before the charitable deduction and DRD
Dividends-received deduction
rows.explanation: 65% × 100,000 = **65,000**; the taxable income limit isn't binding.
